headword: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}
gloss: acting on one's own authority; going it alone

definitions.gloss: acting on one's own authority; acting arbitrarily without consultation
definitions.explanation: Making decisions and taking action unilaterally without consulting others or seeking approval. Carries a negative connotation of overstepping authority.

examples.japanese: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Acting on your own authority is not permitted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}らせた→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
examples.english: The subordinates grew increasingly frustrated with the department head's unilateral actions.

examples.japanese: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んで→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧しまい、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: By signing the contract without authorization, they caused great damage to the company.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning to decide and act without consulting others. Composed of ⟦{独断|どくだん}→独断：08658_dokudan⟧ (arbitrary decision) + {専行|せんこう} (acting on one's own). Almost always negative — implies overstepping boundaries or ignoring proper procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act arbitrarily
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to allow unilateral action
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{戒|いまし}める→戒める：17517_imashimeru⟧: to warn against acting alone
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide unilaterally

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独断|どくだん}→独断：08658_dokudan⟧: arbitrary decision — the decision alone, without the action
- {独|ひと}り{走|ばし}り: going off on one's own — more colloquial
- ⟦ワンマン→ワンマン：11210_wanman⟧: one-man (management style) — focuses on autocratic leadership
- {越権行為|えっけんこうい}: act of overstepping one's authority — legal/formal term
